_doc: Smoke-test run config: the sub-11tiny fixture (10x10x1x18), small enough that a full
A->B->D run finishes in about a second. Used by test_dce_pipeline_contracts.py.
This fixture predates the dceprep naming convention -- its dynamic lives under rawdata
and its masks lack the space-DCEref_ prefix -- so every input is named explicitly here
and auto-discovery does not apply. See docs/bids_fixture_naming_alignment_plan.md.
Settings not listed under stage_overrides resolve from python/dce_defaults.json.
'relaxivity' comes from the desc-tinymeta.json sidecar named below, which outranks this
file for per-scan values -- restating it here would have had no effect.
